configuration.profile: One selected fl2va-sr/ref2va-sr JSON; mount under /etc/h3-sr, never over /opt/h3-sr
configuration.gateway-command.json: JSON list of Dingo flags only, beginning with --model. Launcher fixes sys.executable -B -m dingo.vllm.omni; no shell string.

gateway_required_values.--request-adapter-workflow: fl2va or ref2va matching selected profile

configuration.gateway_deployment_values: Namespace/component/endpoint, served model alias, DYN discovery/request/event connection settings and credentials are deployment-owned; do not store credentials in image or command file.
configuration.public_model_pool: Enable adapter_options.enable_sr=true only for the production H3/SR model pool.

startup_order: Offline installed-source verification and converted-weight verification
Same-container Dingo worker; register_model then gateway-ready.json receipt
Supervisor verifies Gateway PID/birth, profile SHA and epoch before public Ready

probes.kind: K8S exec probe inside the worker container; supervisor does not bind Pod IP
probes.ready: Requires native models, exact Gateway registration receipt, all three owned processes, no blocked latch.

storage.sr_source: Read-only /models/SeedVR2-3B is required by worker verify-only as well as CPU init
storage.sr_converted: /opt/sr/seedvr2-3b; initContainer writes UID1000, worker mounts read-only
storage.working: Writable /work; durable control path /work/h3-sr/control; preserve old failure evidence

observability.default: off; business peak sampling, memory/NVML/per-PID/block hooks, offload timing, Cache-DiT summary and periodic native statistics disabled
observability.stages: Explicit timing only; deployment must inject actual final H3SR_IMAGE_DIGEST as repository@sha256, never substitute parent digest
observability.timing_summary: Native H3 header plus validated sr-timing-only/1 receipts. Nested/inclusive durations are not additive; no allocator/NVML samples.

recovery: Unknown/cancel/timeout retains active lease and blocked state. Do not clear old evidence or auto-replay. Confirm old backend completion, then perform explicit fresh Pod/epoch/workspace recovery.
public_sr: Each request chooses zero or one sr_tier. Both output tiers from separate H3 requests have separate lineage; this image does not add same-Base two-tier generation.
acceptance_boundary: Local CPU and actual-image CPU/source validation do not prove CUDA inference, FL new combination, Ref production-path quality, Gateway media E2E or load capacity.
